input.instruction: In /testbed/crates/hir-ty/src/infer.rs (and related), find fn identity_args and where generic_def is determined for InferenceContext (probably from owner DefWithBodyId, including Variant). Report code of identity_args, and how generic_def is computed (DefWithBodyId::generic_def in hir-def).

content.content: {"summary":"identity_args is a lazily cached method on InferenceContext. It builds identity generic args from store_owner, not from generic_def. generic_def is passed into InferenceContext::new by the callers. For a body it comes from DefWithBodyId::generic_def.","findings":["infer.rs:1995-1999: `fn identity_args(&self) -> GenericArgs<'db> { *self.identity_args.get_or_init(|| { GenericArgs::identity_for_item(self.interner(), self.store_owner.into()) }) }`","infer.rs:134-138 (infer_query): InferenceContext::new(db, InferBodyId::DefWithBodyId(def), ExpressionStoreOwnerId::Body(def), def.generic_def(db), &body.store, resolver).","infer.rs:208: for anon consts, `loc.owner.generic_def(db)` is passed instead, and the owner is `store_owner`.","infer.rs:1273: the struct field is `pub(crate) generic_def: GenericDefId`. It is used at 1377 for `db.trait_environment(generic_def)` and at 1992 for `generics(db, self.generic_def)`.","hir-def/src/lib.rs:876-883: DefWithBodyId::generic_def maps FunctionId, StaticId and ConstId to the same id converted into a GenericDefId. VariantId(c) maps to `c.lookup(db).parent.into()`, which is the parent enum.","hir-def/src/lib.rs:954-969: ExpressionStoreOwnerId::generic_def does the same for Body. Signature returns its own id. VariantFields maps an EnumVariantId to its parent enum, and a struct or union to itself."],"confidence":0.9}

content.text: Simplest: use generic_def for identity args.
